title: Cow in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- cow body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='20' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='56' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#3a3a5a'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='66' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#3a3a5a'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='76' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
  <rect x='44' y='78' width='7' height='13' rx='3' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
  <rect x='56' y='78' width='7' height='13' rx='3' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
  <rect x='68' y='76' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='30' y='87' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8a5a3a'/>
  <rect x='44' y='88' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8a5a3a'/>
  <rect x='56' y='88' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8a5a3a'/>
  <rect x='68' y='87' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8a5a3a'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M28 50 Q50 58 72 50 L72 56 Q50 64 28 56 Z' fill='#e14b4b'/>
  <path d='M66 54 L78 66 L72 70 L62 58 Z' fill='#c73636'/>
  <!-- scarf stripe -->
  <path d='M28 52 Q50 60 72 52' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='18' ry='15' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <!-- head spot -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='29' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#3a3a5a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='32' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='32' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <path d='M38 23 Q36 16 41 15' stroke='#d9c08a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 23 Q64 16 59 15' stroke='#d9c08a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='12' ry='8' fill='#ffd8d0'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='44' r='1.8' fill='#8a5a6a'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='44' r='1.8' fill='#8a5a6a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='35' r='3' fill='#3a3a5a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='35' r='3' fill='#3a3a5a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='34' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
